lines.zh: 我用四条石腿走，声音很碎
lines.en: I walk on four stone legs, a gritty sound.

lines.zh: 每走一步，身上掉一点沙砾
lines.en: Each step sheds a little gravel.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛是一排小石子
lines.en: My mane is a row of small stones.

lines.zh: 我不需要草，我只需要地面
lines.en: I need no grass; only ground.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石走，越走越松
lines.en: I walk the scree, and it loosens under me.

lines.zh: 我的蹄印是浅坑，不是蹄形
lines.en: My prints are shallow pits, not hooves.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，石头不会累
lines.en: I walk steadily; stone does not tire.

lines.zh: 我身上有灵魂沙的暗色纹
lines.en: Dark soul-sand veins run through me.

lines.zh: 我跟着骑手的方向走
lines.en: I walk where my rider points.

lines.zh: 我从黏土地走到石头地上
lines.en: I go from clay soil onto stone.

lines.zh: 我的关节响一下，又继续走
lines.en: A joint clicks, and I walk on.

lines.zh: 我走路时沙粒从缝里漏下来
lines.en: Grit leaks from my seams as I walk.

lines.zh: 我不喘，也不出汗
lines.en: I do not pant, and I do not sweat.

lines.zh: 我一步步踩实，从不虚踏
lines.en: I plant each step, never a false one.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一块被凿出来的石头
lines.en: I stand like a stone that has been carved.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵不动，是固定的
lines.en: My ears do not move; they are fixed.

lines.zh: 风把沙面吹得更糙
lines.en: The wind roughens my surface.

lines.zh: 我身上的沙砾在慢慢掉
lines.en: My gravel slowly falls away.

lines.zh: 我在等有人上来
lines.en: I wait for someone to mount.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两个凹坑
lines.en: My eyes are two hollows.

lines.zh: 地面有一点震动，我感觉到了
lines.en: A slight tremor in the ground; I feel it.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴僵着，放不下来
lines.en: My tail is stiff and will not lower.

lines.zh: 我是被捏出来的，不是生的
lines.en: I was shaped, not born.

lines.zh: 阳光晒得我的表面发热
lines.en: The sun warms my surface.

lines.zh: 我这一身，随时会散
lines.en: This body of mine could come apart anytime.

lines.zh: 我闻到黏土的味道，就在附近
lines.en: I smell clay close by.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，比动更像石头
lines.en: Standing still, I look more like stone.

lines.zh: 我的侧面有一道裂纹
lines.en: A crack runs down my side.

lines.zh: 休息对石头没有意义
lines.en: Rest means nothing to stone.

lines.zh: 我转过头，沙粒跟着落
lines.en: I turn my head and gravel falls.

lines.zh: 你在看我的裂纹
lines.en: You are looking at my crack.

lines.zh: 我往后退了一步，很轻
lines.en: I step back, lightly.

lines.zh: 我的骑手不在，我不认你
lines.en: My rider is gone; I do not know you.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就走开
lines.en: Come closer and I will walk off.

lines.zh: 我是石头做的，不怕你看
lines.en: I am made of stone; looking does not trouble me.

lines.zh: 我低头，用凹坑对着你
lines.en: I lower my head, hollows toward you.

lines.zh: 我们没有敌意，也没有好意
lines.en: We bear no ill will, and no good will either.

lines.zh: 你身上有灵魂沙的味道吗
lines.en: Do you carry the smell of soul sand?

lines.zh: 我等你做什么
lines.en: I wait to see what you do.

lines.zh: 我的四条腿都稳着
lines.en: All four of my legs are planted.

lines.zh: 你站远一点，我不想掉沙
lines.en: Stand back; I do not want to shed on you.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬前腿，又放下
lines.en: I lift a foreleg, then set it down.

lines.zh: 我不点头，我只会转脖子
lines.en: I cannot nod; I can only turn my neck.

lines.zh: 我被砸掉一块，沙撒了一地
lines.en: A piece is knocked off; gravel scatters.

lines.zh: 我叫不出来，我只能晃
lines.en: I cannot cry out; I can only sway.

lines.zh: 我的腿短了一截
lines.en: One leg is shorter now.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，石头在地上磨
lines.en: I give half a step, stone grinding.

lines.zh: 这一下让我轻了不少
lines.en: That made me a good deal lighter.

lines.zh: 我身体里的灵魂沙露出来了
lines.en: The soul sand inside me shows.

lines.zh: 这副架子还能站着
lines.en: This frame can still stand.

lines.zh: 我的关节松了，走起来晃
lines.en: My joints have loosened; I wobble.

lines.zh: 再打两下，我就散
lines.en: Two more hits and I scatter.

lines.zh: 我不吃草，我吃石头
lines.en: I do not eat grass; I eat stone.

lines.zh: 这东西不是砂砾
lines.en: This is not gravel.

lines.zh: 你给我，我也吞不下去
lines.en: Give it to me and I still cannot swallow.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，没有用
lines.en: I sniff; useless.

lines.zh: 你把砂砾放在地上，我会踩过去
lines.en: Lay gravel down and I will walk over it.

lines.zh: 这东西软得没用
lines.en: This is too soft to be useful.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢脚下一片碎石
lines.en: I prefer scree underfoot.

lines.zh: 别拿这个喂我
lines.en: Do not try to feed me this.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我晃了一下，沙落了
lines.en: You hit me; I sway, and gravel falls.

lines.zh: 石头比肉沉，你知道的
lines.en: Stone is heavier than flesh; you know that.

lines.zh: 这一下在我身上磕掉一角
lines.en: That chipped a corner off me.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，石头在地上刮
lines.en: I back two steps, stone scraping earth.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音像碎瓷
lines.en: We collide with a sound like broken pottery.

lines.zh: 我没有疼，只是掉了一些
lines.en: I feel no pain, only loss.

lines.zh: 我重新站好，四条腿对正
lines.en: I set myself again, all four legs aligned.

lines.zh: 你的肩会被我硌疼
lines.en: My flank will bruise your shoulder.

lines.zh: 地上的碎石被我们踩得更碎
lines.en: We grind the gravel finer.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就散给你看
lines.en: Once more and I will come apart for you.

lines.zh: 我们是捏出来的，不会成对
lines.en: We are shaped, not bred; we do not pair.

lines.zh: 两匹黏土马站在一起，很像
lines.en: Two clay horses side by side look alike.

lines.zh: 我们不需要那个，我们只需要骑手
lines.en: We need no such thing; only riders.

lines.zh: 并排站着，我们的影子连成一块
lines.en: Standing abreast, our shadows join.

lines.zh: 谁先散，另一个就替它站着
lines.en: Whichever crumbles first, the other stands in its place.

lines.zh: 同类之间，只有并排
lines.en: Between kin, only standing abreast.

lines.zh: 我们不交谈，石头不说话
lines.en: We do not talk; stone does not speak.

lines.zh: 一起走的时候，沙落得更快
lines.en: Walking together, we shed faster.

lines.zh: 同一批黏土做出来的
lines.en: Made from the same batch of clay.

lines.zh: 我们一起等骑手
lines.en: We wait for riders together.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼，但嘴是石头的
lines.en: I try to take it in my mouth, but my mouth is stone.

lines.zh: 我叼不住，它滑下来
lines.en: I cannot hold it; it slides out.

lines.zh: 我把它踩在蹄下
lines.en: I press it under a hoof.

lines.zh: 这东西硌在我的关节里
lines.en: It jams in my joint.

lines.zh: 我推了一下，它滚出去
lines.en: I nudge it, and it rolls away.

lines.zh: 我生来就没有手
lines.en: I was made without hands.

lines.zh: 我只有脖子能低下去
lines.en: I can only lower my neck.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我不捡
lines.en: It fell; I do not pick it up.

lines.zh: 我用鼻端顶了顶
lines.en: I butt it with my muzzle.

lines.zh: 这一点重量，我没感觉
lines.en: This weight means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 前面有东西在动
lines.en: Something moves ahead.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向转过去
lines.en: I turn that way.

lines.zh: 我的骑手若在，就该冲了
lines.en: If my rider were here, we would charge.

lines.zh: 我把脖子压下去
lines.en: I press my neck down.

lines.zh: 地上的震动能告诉我距离
lines.en: Tremors in the ground tell me the distance.

lines.zh: 我不叫，石头不会叫
lines.en: I make no call; stone does not call.

lines.zh: 我换成了小跑
lines.en: I have broken into a trot.

lines.zh: 这方向没有障碍
lines.en: Nothing blocks this line.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子已经刨地了
lines.en: My hooves already scrape the ground.

lines.zh: 锁定的就是那个
lines.en: That is the one I have marked.

lines.zh: 我身上的沙在往下落
lines.en: Grit falls off me as I move.

lines.zh: 这一趟我会跑到散为止
lines.en: I will run until I come apart.

lines.zh: 沙砾从关节缝里往下漏
lines.en: Gravel leaks from the seams of my joints

lines.zh: 它躲到树后，我绕过去
lines.en: It hides behind a tree; I go around.

lines.zh: 我不快，但不会停
lines.en: I am not fast, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 沙从我身上落下，像一条痕迹
lines.en: Gravel falls off me like a trail.

lines.zh: 我在算它还有几步
lines.en: I count the steps it has left.

lines.zh: 它退到石堆上，那里不好走
lines.en: It backs onto rubble; poor footing there.

lines.zh: 我的腿有点松了
lines.en: My legs have loosened.

lines.zh: 我再跑一段就到了
lines.en: Another stretch and I am there.

lines.zh: 它跑不过我，石头不累
lines.en: It cannot outrun me; stone does not tire.

lines.zh: 最后我放慢，稳住身子
lines.en: At the end I slow, steadying myself.

lines.zh: 我低头，对准了
lines.en: I lower my head and take aim.

lines.zh: 这一下我不留余力
lines.en: This time I hold nothing back.

lines.zh: 地面一直响着
lines.en: The ground keeps sounding.

lines.zh: 我用前蹄砸下去
lines.en: I bring a forehoof down.

lines.zh: 我拿整副身子撞上去
lines.en: I throw my whole frame at you.

lines.zh: 这一下有重量，没有巧劲
lines.en: Heavy, with no finesse.

lines.zh: 我撞完自己掉了一角
lines.en: After the hit, a corner of me falls off.

lines.zh: 你被顶退了几步
lines.en: You are shoved back several steps.

lines.zh: 我的头是实心的
lines.en: My head is solid.

lines.zh: 我甩头，沙甩到你脸上
lines.en: I toss my head, flinging grit in your face.

lines.zh: 我又退回去，重新站好
lines.en: I back off and set myself again.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了整个身子
lines.en: That used my whole frame.

lines.zh: 到现在我还没散
lines.en: I have not come apart yet.

lines.zh: 一堆砂砾自己立了起来
lines.en: A heap of gravel stands itself up.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙的暗纹在我身上成形
lines.en: Soul-sand veins take shape on me.

lines.zh: 我被人捏成马的样子
lines.en: I was shaped into a horse.

lines.zh: 我落地时，脚边散了一圈沙
lines.en: When I land, gravel scatters at my feet.

lines.zh: 我没有呼吸，只有重量
lines.en: I have no breath, only weight.

lines.zh: 我被放在这里，等人来骑
lines.en: I was set here for someone to ride.

lines.zh: 地表裂了一点，我的蹄陷进去
lines.en: The ground cracks; my hooves sink in.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛还湿着
lines.en: My mane is still damp.

lines.zh: 有人在附近，我能感觉到震动
lines.en: Someone is near; I feel the tremors.

lines.zh: 我第一次动，关节咔了一声
lines.en: On my first move, a joint clicks.

lines.zh: 砂砾从我的背上滚下来
lines.en: Gravel rolls off my back.

lines.zh: 我抬起前腿，站稳了
lines.en: I lift my forelegs and plant myself.

lines.zh: 我不是活的，但我能走
lines.en: I am not alive, but I can walk.

lines.zh: 我身上还有捏制时的指痕
lines.en: The marks of shaping hands remain on me.

lines.zh: 我朝空地的中间走了几步
lines.en: I walk a few steps to the middle of the clearing.

lines.zh: 我停下来，等第一个骑手
lines.en: I stop and wait for the first rider.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的石头，表面炸开
lines.en: Fire bakes my stone; the surface cracks open.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，碎成几块又拼起来
lines.en: I hit the ground and break into pieces, then reassemble.

lines.zh: 水渗进我的缝里，我变重了
lines.en: Water seeps into my seams; I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我崩散了半边
lines.en: The blast blows half of me apart.

lines.zh: 一块石子打在我身上，留下坑
lines.en: A stone strikes me, leaving a pit.

lines.zh: 那股力把我捏得更紧
lines.en: That force presses me tighter together.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我不会饿
lines.en: I eat nothing; I cannot starve.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我的表面裂成网
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my surface cracks into a web.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我散在半空
lines.en: No ground; I come apart in the air.
